summary: NLCS Game 4, Brewers lead 3-0: Glasnow vs. swingman Shane Drohan in an elimination game. Lineups are posted; it's 89 degrees with wind blowing out to right.

legs.note: Glasnow (11.9 K per 9) faces Shane Drohan, a swingman with a 4.19 ERA who allowed 6 and 5 runs in his last two real starts. The Dodgers are at home facing elimination, with Milwaukee's bullpen used again last night.

It's 89 degrees with wind blowing out to right at Dodger Stadium, which helps fly balls carry. Drohan won't go deep, so Milwaukee will need a lot of relievers against a Dodgers lineup that scored 801 runs this season.

extra_legs.note: Glasnow averaged 7.5 strikeouts a start this season (11.9 per 9 innings) and had 6 or more in 5 of his last 6 starts. Milwaukee strikes out 22% of the time, and the Dodgers have no reason to pull him early in an elimination game.
